judgment.notes: N001 applies to u0 and every smooth truncation in the same real mean-zero H^gamma ball. Since gamma>0, both initial L^2 norms are at most R, so B0=2R>0 is valid. N007 applies at the fixed positive tau=T/L to every mean-zero iterate. N011 applies to each truncation with the same C,tau0, since all its datum and step conditions hold. N006 unitarity at s=0 and N007 endpoint matching apply to the smooth trajectories. There are no E/M applications.
